{{Quote|With Star Tours you will be safe and mostly assured that you're in the fastest vehicle this side of the Outer Rim... the all-new Starspeeder 1000!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Disneyland">{{Disney|domain=go.com|subdomain=disneyland|url=disneyland/star-tours|text=Star Tours – The Adventures Continue|oldversion=20120501022553}}</ref>}}
The '''StarSpeeder 1000''' was a model of transport [[Starship/Legends|starship]] once operated by the interstellar spaceline [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] and the five other travel agencies that made up the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. They could accommodate forty seated passengers and required a crew of only three to operate effectively. While all StarSpeeder 1000s bore the Star Tours logo, the color and markings of an individual craft varied according to its destination.
The StarSpeeder 1000s were the predecessors of the mostly identical [[StarSpeeder 3000]] that were seen shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|When the automatic doors have opened, please proceed directly across the ramp into the cabin. Continue to move all the way across your aisle, filling in every available seat.|[[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]] delivering safety instructions|<ref name="ST:AC" />}}
[[File:StarSpeeder1000_views.png|thumb|left|200px|Front, rear and side views of a StarSpeeder 1000]]

Sturdy and trapezoidal, the Starspeeder 1000 could accommodate up to forty passengers at a time. Both sides of the Starspeeder 1000 featured five automatic doors that provided access to the rows of seats. The cabin was also height-rated specifically for [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] passengers. While the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency advertised its transport as "the most sophisticated and luxurious spaceliner in its class," the cabin of the Starspeeder 1000 was rather spartan. It featured little more than a passenger seating area and a small piloting deck with a front [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]]&mdash;occupied by a [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] and a [[systems analyst]]. There was also a small monitor next to the cockpit screen. It could be used to either see what the IC-360 camera was seeing or show the astromech copiloting the ship, along with other pilots in their ships. An [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was also loaded into a proper [[Astromech socket/Legends|slot]] outside of the ship.<ref name="Playset" /> Additionally, each StarSpeeder 1000 was equipped with its own [[IC-360 camera droid]], which would venture out of the transport and deliver close-up images of dangerous creatures or exotic locales to passengers in the cabin. The viewport also had its own automatic cleaning system.<ref name="ST:AC" />

However, despite its shortcomings, the transport was equipped with advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]],<ref name="Playset" /> and all the seats had personal [[Restraint harness|safety belts]],<ref name="ST:AC" /> called [[gravitic harness]]es. The cabin was also equipped with ray shielding,<ref name="Tokyo2" /> and the front of the vehicle was furbished with two [[Flashcannon|flash cannons]], heavy-duty plasma cannons, and two concealed [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], a defensive armament to be used in case of safety-threatening encounters; the concealed cannons were abnormally powerful for a passenger liner, as one was observed dealing heavy damage to the bridge of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], engulfing it in flames, and could also destroy a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] in one shot.<ref name="Playset" /> The StarSpeeder 1000 was also designed to operate in aquatic environments. Its front side was even equipped with a pair of headlamps, which allowed the shuttle to navigate in dark, murky [[Water/Legends|waters]] such as the ones of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="ST:AC" /> It also possessed suborbital thrusters and multi-terrain skids, as well as shielding and protection against dark matter and temporal disturbances.<ref name="Tokyo2" />

The starspeeder also had a holographic projector placed on the roof near the cockpit window. It could be activated by an astromech droid and was used to send urgent messages to the crew of the ship.

The most basic design model had colors of red, white and blue on the hull, with the red being most prevalent on the dorsal area, the white in the middle area, and the blue in the ventral area. However, there were five different hull designs besides the regular design, depending on the model's primary destination.

===StarSpeeder 1000 hyperdrive===
The StarSpeeder 1000's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was a [[Nubian]]-compatible [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]]. It was composed of Null Quantum Field chargeplates, 14 pairs of plasma focusers, alluvial dampers of the VGL KKC type, coolant arrays, antimatter transpactors, two cabin coolant arrays, tandem control dampers magnetic stabilizers, inertial dampers, a chargeplate with overflow safeties, a tri-valent array, an induction assembly, a class 4 shielding, a fusion injector array, and a gravic recorder.<ref name="Tokyo2" />

==History==
{{Quote|All passengers, please prepare for immediate boarding!|Aly San San|<ref name="ST:AC" />}}
[[File:StarSpeeder1000_passengers.png|thumb|250px|Passengers seated in the cabin of a StarSpeeder 1000 chartered by Star Tours]]

The StarSpeeder 1000s were designed by [[Sacul Aerospace]]<ref name="Blog" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the [[Corellian/Legends|inhabitants]] of which had a long-established reputation of crafting fast star cruisers.<ref name="ATSS">{{Disney|domain=go.com|url=star-tours-adventures/starspeeder|text=About the starspeeder}}</ref> The ship was certified by [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], its tech was wavied by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and its security was rated by [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="Tokyo2" />

Those sturdy transports were used by Star Tours in the [[Time/Legends|time]] span from [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date" /> During that period, five other spacelines affiliated with Star Tours through the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]] also made use of the StarSpeeder 1000.<ref name="Blog" /> The Star Tours travel agency, however, advertised those ships as its trademark, stating that it enjoyed exclusive use of them.<ref name="EnEx">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours-2/2011/06/star-tours-the-adventures-continue-june-3-2011/attachment/img_0659-2|text=IMG_0659}}</ref>

At some point after the rise of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and its installation on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="ST2 date" /> the [[Star Tours Flight 1401]] bound to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was ambushed by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who had detected the presence of a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in the craft. In an unfortunate turn of events before the passengers and the spy board, [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accidentally replace [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]] as the pilot via getting trapped by the autopilot in the cockpit of the ship. When he discover the spy on board, he tried his best to escape the Imperials and finally deliver the spy to safety.<ref name="ST:AC" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="LC blog">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the StarSpeeder 1000 had been superseded by the largely identical [[StarSpeeder 3000]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> However, the new 3000s did not remain in service for too long, since the Star Tours company was driven out of business a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, after a series of accidents.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarSpeeder1000.jpg|thumb|A prototype StarSpeeder 1000 toy, with only three doors per side]]
The StarSpeeder 1000s first appeared in ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', a [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme-park]] attraction located at [[Disneyland]] in [[Wikipedia:California|California]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World Resort|Walt Disney World]] in [[Wikipedia:Florida|Florida]].<ref name="StarToursReturns">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/news20090912/index.html|text=A Re-Imagined Star Tours to Blast Off in California and Florida in 2011}}</ref> ''The Adventures Continue'' was a [[2011]] update of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction, which was originally launched in [[1987]].<ref name="Disneyworld">{{Disney|subdomain=disneyworld|domain=go.com|url=parks/hollywood-studios/attractions/star-tours|text=''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue''}}</ref>

Early teaser footage for ''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue'' revealed that part of the ride would include the StarSpeeder 1000, bursting into the Boonta Eve Classic pod race. In a high-resolution image of the scene provided to various media outlets, the 1000 designation on the speeder could be seen.<ref name="SWArchive-Download the Last Issue of the French ''Star Wars Magazine''">{{SWArchive|url=fans/media/news20100122swm/index.html|text=Download the Last Issue of the French ''Star Wars Magazine''}} &ndash; The last issue of the French ''Star Wars Magazine'' high resolution image shows that the speeder is a StarSpeeder 1000.</ref>

The computer model of the StarSpeeder 1000 was later used in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''The Force Awakens'']], in the background of [[Niima Outpost]] on the planet [[Jakku]].<ref>{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours-2/2016/04/star-tours-awakens-no-foolin|text=Star Tours Awakens (No Foolin!)}}</ref>
